guarantees.claim: After reset is deasserted, lsio_trigger_o is set to 1 on the next positive clock edge and remains 1 permanently.
guarantees.cond: !rst_ni on negedge rst_ni, then posedge clk_i

uncertain_points.claim: lsio_trigger_o transitions 0→1 only once after reset and then stays high; downstream logic expecting a pulse or edge may miss the event or see a constant level instead of a trigger.
uncertain_points.cond: After rst_ni is released, lsio_trigger_o remains asserted indefinitely.
uncertain_points.risk: Downstream DMA FSM may stall or fail to initiate new transfers because it expects a subsequent deassertion or a pulse pattern.

uncertain_points.claim: The chunk is tagged with a compile-time guard 'generate if: !rst_ni' but the always_ff block internally references and uses rst_ni as an active-low reset; the guard may be misapplied or the extraction metadata inconsistent.
uncertain_points.cond: When the generate condition evaluates to true, the block is instanced.
uncertain_points.risk: If the guard is real, referencing rst_ni would cause synthesis failure; if it is a metadata error, the risk is negligible but may cause confusion during review.
